newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse P/E ratio eases to 13.89 in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse P/E ratio eases to 13.89 in Sept.

text.p: The market price/earnings ratio eased to 13.89 in September from 13.91 in August, on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE), the BSE said in its monthly report.
The market price/book value slipped to 1.43 in September from 1.44 in August, it said.
The dividend yield remained unchanged at 1.45 percent. @
MARKET RATIOS ON THE BUDAPEST STOCK EXCHANGE
P/E ratio P/BV ratio Dividend yield(pct)

NOTE: From September 1995, the BSE has calculated P/E ratios by dividing total share capitalisation by total after-tax results (profits and losses). Previously P/E ratios were calculated for each company and were weighted by their registered capital. @
At the end of September total share capitalisation stood at 716.9 billion forints, easing a shade from 717.9 billion at the end of August. -- Budapest newsroom (36 10 327-4040
